posts.text: Russia is again attacking civilian targets in Kyiv tonight. Residents might have been watching the World Cup as the missiles fell. Such attacks are a feature, not a bug, of Russian tactics since its full-scale invasion four and a half years ago. #Ukraine (photo via Reuters)
posts.summary: Condemns Russian attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine
